shortDescription: By Bianca FlowersAn Amazon Prime Air cargo flight overran a runway at Miami International Airport on Sunday, prompting the closure of all runways and taxiways and a ground stop, airport officials said.

children: An Amazon Prime Air cargo flight overran a runway at Miami International Airport on Sunday, prompting the closure of all runways and taxiways and a ground stop, airport officials said.
Prime Air Flight 7598 overran the airport's diagonal runway at about 2 p.m. ET (1800 GMT) and was disabled at the airport's northwest end, officials said.
All runways and taxiways were closed as of 3 p.m. ET (1900 GMT)
Information on injuries or fatalities was not immediately available.
The Federal Aviation Administration said it will investigate the crash.
